steps.telegram_business: Enter the bot token → Save → mode "Demo" → "Register webhook". Then in Telegram: Settings → Telegram Business → Chatbots → add the bot with the reply right.
steps.whatsapp_cloud: Meta for Developers → your app → WhatsApp → Configuration → Callback URL = this URL, Verify token = the field above; subscribe to the messages field.
steps.viber: Enter the bot token (partners.viber.com) → Save → mode "Demo" → "Register webhook".
steps.phonet: Phonet account → API / Webhooks → the URL above with your token ("Webhook token" field). Event format not confirmed.
steps.ringostat: Ringostat → Integrations → Webhooks → event "After the call", the URL above with your token; fields — see the Channels module docs.
steps.binotel: Binotel → Settings → API CALL COMPLETED → the URL above with your token. Format not confirmed.

extension.title: Browser extension
extension.explain: SinHRM Clipper adds a candidate from the profile page you are viewing (LinkedIn, Work.ua, Djinni, DOU) in one click. It uses a personal token instead of your session.
extension.inactive: No active token. Create one and paste it into the extension settings.
extension.onceHint: It is shown only once. Creating a new token revokes this one.
extension.error: Could not update the token. Try again.

install.step1: Download sinhrm-clipper.zip (built by CI or with npm run package in extension/) and unzip it.
install.step2: Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
install.step3: Click “Load unpacked” and choose the unzipped folder.
install.step4: Open the extension options, paste the token and click “Check connection”.

extension.privacy: The extension reads only the page you are viewing and only when you click its button. It does not crawl or scrape in the background.
